responsibility: Implements the CFG and SSA rewriting machinery that realizes registered jump-threading opportunities. It stores thread paths, validates and filters illegal loop-rotating or backedge-sensitive paths, duplicates or rewires blocks for forward and backward threading styles, updates PHIs and redirected edges, estimates dead statements eliminated by a thread, and provides the path-registry implementations that batch CFG changes after candidate discovery.
same_name_distinction: This file realizes already-registered threading opportunities by rewriting CFG and SSA form: validating paths, duplicating/rewiring blocks, updating PHIs and edges, and estimating dead statements. The companion gcc/tree-ssa-threadupdate.h only defines the path/edge representation, registry classes, and helper declarations used to request and organize those updates.
